title: These Are Pretty
text: These Are Pretty. If they didn't include so many huge marbles and put it four or more mid-small size it would be so much nicer. The large marbles are SO much bigger than the rest they just seem out of place. Colors and shades are nice. We have them in a dish surrounding a large candle.
